import Icon from '../components/Icon.astro';
import FaqList from '../components/FaqList.astro';

<Base title="Visual contract test" description="Temporary test of a new route inheriting the shared design system." path="/visual-contract-fixture/" noindex>
  <div class="container-page page-head">
    <h1>Visual contract test</h1>
    <p>A new route needs no local CSS to inherit its shell and actions.</p>
    <Icon name="room" />
    <Action href="/contact/">Navigation action</Action>
    <Action variant="secondary">Native button</Action>
    <Action href="/contact/" aria-disabled="true">Unavailable navigation</Action>
    <Action aria-disabled="true">Unavailable button</Action>
    <form data-action-form>
      <label>Fixture input <input name="fixture" value="Original" /></label>
      <Action type="submit">Submit fixture</Action>
      <Action type="reset" variant="secondary">Reset fixture</Action>
      <output data-action-submissions>0</output>
    </form>
  </div>
  <FaqList
    heading="A future page inherits the shared question treatment"
    items={[{ id: 'fixture-rolls', question: 'How many rolls should I order?', paragraphs: ['Use the exact product format and the measured walls before confirming a quantity. This fixture illustrates the shared question layout.'] }]}
  />
  <script is:inline>
    document.querySelector('[data-action-form]').addEventListener('submit', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const output = document.querySelector('[data-action-submissions]');
      output.textContent = String(Number(output.textContent) + 1);
    });
  </script>
</Base>
